experiment_data.hypothesis: Bootstrap SE (B=200, re-estimating CM + re-fitting CF per bootstrap) can close the CausalForest under-coverage gap (91% vs nominal 95%) by properly accounting for CM estimation uncertainty that plug-in SE ignores.

metrics.key_finding: Bootstrap SE closes the CF under-coverage gap: plugin 81.7% → bootstrap 94.2% (+12.5pp, near-nominal 95%). Oracle CF itself only 82.5% coverage — CF plug-in SE is inherently under-calibrated. Bootstrap SE is ~1.4x larger than plug-in SE. High-error subgroup s1: plugin 80.0% → bootstrap 96.7%.
